posts.text:
Usually it's a rehash of the exact post they reply to with nothing added, often a question

Then you check their other replies and it's the same endless replying same empty substance replies rehashing a post

AI has only the post as input to work with and has no real personality so it's easy for me to spot

Often they try add humanization to it like write only in lowercase or adding genz slang like fr etc. but it's still an AI reply

What shocks me is how many people can't detect AI replies already now, long term we'll have no way to detect as models get better. Probably already I'm not able to detect many!

It's funny to see the shitstorm of people now posting about my blocklist where the majority admits they use AI bots to reply but don't think it's an issue so are outraged about being on a list of AI reply bots! But that's exactly what the list is about so it works! 😁
posts.text_zh:
通常，这些回复只是把被回复的原帖换个说法再复述一遍，什么新东西都没加，还经常是个问句。

然后再去看他们别的回复，会发现也是没完没了地用同样空洞的话术，把原帖再复述一遍。

AI 只能拿原帖当输入，也没有真实个性，所以对我来说很容易一眼认出来。

他们常常会刻意加一点「人性化」，比如全文只用小写，或塞进 fr 这类 genz 俚语，但终究还是 AI 回复。

让我震惊的是，现在居然已经有这么多人辨别不出 AI 回复了。长期来看，随着模型越来越好，我们将完全没法分辨。可能现在就已经有很多我认不出来！

好笑的是，现在一堆人在发帖讨论我的 blocklist，其中大多数都承认自己在用 AI 机器人回复，却觉得这不是问题，还因为被列进 AI 回复机器人名单而愤怒！但这份名单本来就是干这个的，所以它起作用了！😁

quoted.text: @levelsio I feel so naive… how do you know when a reply is AI generated? I looked at some of the blocked people on your list and what replies they have been blocked for. For some the AI was quite obvious, for others I had no idea. How do you spot it?
quoted.text_zh: @levelsio 我觉得自己好天真……你是怎么判断一条回复是 AI 生成的？我看了你名单里一些被屏蔽的人，以及他们因为哪些回复被屏蔽。有的 AI 痕迹很明显，有的我完全看不出来。你是怎么发现的？

quoted.text:
Jensen Huang told Nvidia staff they’d become so rich that the only way to get more work out of them was through humiliation, The New York Times reports.

As Nvidia’s wealth soared, Huang grew increasingly frustrated with his employees, according to three people who spoke on condition of anonymity. He told groups of subordinates he couldn’t motivate them with money anymore.

The Times says it was part of a decades-long pattern of berating employees, according to documents and interviews:

- He told one executive his mother should have aborted him, according to one witness.
- He said he would rip both arms off a subordinate and beat the person to death with them.
- He told another employee he would rip off the top of their head and “pee on your brain.”
quoted.text_zh:
《纽约时报》(The New York Times) 报道，Jensen Huang 对 Nvidia 员工说，他们已经变得太有钱，唯一还能让他们多干活的办法就是羞辱。

据三名要求匿名的人士称，随着 Nvidia 的财富飙升，Huang 对员工越来越不满。他对下属们说，已经没法再用钱来激励他们了。

The Times 根据文件和采访称，这是他长达数十年辱骂员工模式的一部分：

- 据一名目击者称，他对一名高管说，他妈妈当初应该把他堕掉。
- 他说他会把一名下属的双臂撕下来，再用这两条胳膊把对方打死。
- 他对另一名员工说，他会掀开对方的头顶，「往你脑子上撒尿」。
